project.central_question: Among cases with the same missing sequence, can ensemble disagreement identify which cases are likely to fail?
project.research_question: When MRI sequences are missing at inference, does the case-level ensemble uncertainty of a modality-dropout nnU-Net discriminate unreliable enhancing-tumour segmentations within a given missing-sequence condition, i.e. beyond what the known identity of the missing sequence provides? How does this vary with which sequence is missing, and do the discrimination and operating thresholds transfer to a held-out institution and an external population?
project.title: Case-level reliability of glioma segmentation under missing MRI sequences
